title: Head Data Scientist
description:
Role & responsibilities
The Head Data Scientist will own Data Science strategy, delivery quality, and production outcomes for the AI CoE. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for setting modeling and evaluation standards, driving measurable business impact, and ensuring solutions are production-grade, governed, and Responsible-AI aligned.
You will lead a team of 8 to 10 Data Scientists and coordinate partner resources where applicable, working closely with AI Product, AI Architecture, Data Engineering, MLOps, Cloud, and Security/IRM teams to deliver scalable and reliable AI capabilities.
Retail domain expertise is a must; Oil & Energy is a strong plus.
Key Responsibilities
1) DS Strategy, Standards & Quality Gates
Define the Data Science vision, modeling standards, and reusable playbooks across AI/advanced analytics and GenAI initiatives.
Establish evaluation frameworks, benchmarking approaches, and quality gates for production readiness (performance thresholds, stability checks, monitoring requirements, retraining triggers).
Build reusable assets: feature engineering patterns, experiment templates, model documentation packs, and governance artifacts.
2) End-to-End Delivery Leadership (Hands-on Oversight)
Lead problem framing with business stakeholders: objectives, constraints, assumptions, success metrics, and value hypotheses.
Oversee end-to-end DS delivery: EDA, feature strategy, modeling, tuning, validation, and readiness for deployment.
Ensure strong experimentation discipline: baselines, ablations, reproducibility, and robust testing for edge cases and data shifts.
3) Advanced Modeling Excellence
Drive excellence across predictive modeling: classification, regression, time-series/forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation/clustering, and recommendation/personalization patterns.
Guide optimization/decision-support components where required, ensuring pragmatic assumptions and measurable outcomes.
Lead model selection and trade-offs across accuracy, interpretability, latency, scalability, and cost.
4) Production Readiness, Governance & Responsible AI
Establish DS governance: documentation standards, interpretability/explainability where required, bias/fairness checks, privacy and sensitive-data handling, and model risk documentation.
Ensure enterprise readiness with Security/IRM: auditability, traceability, approvals, environment discipline, and release evidence.
Define monitoring strategy and operating cadence: drift/quality/latency, business KPI impact, incident handling inputs, and retraining plans.
5) GenAI, Agentic AI Analytics & Evaluation (Where Applicable)
Define evaluation strategy for LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI system outputs: quality metrics, relevance, grounding, hallucination checks, task completion accuracy, safety signals, and feedback loops.
Drive structured testing and release gating evidence for GenAI and autonomous/agent-based AI systems, including human-in-the-loop evaluation where required.
Establish performance monitoring frameworks to assess agent decision flows, tool usage effectiveness, multi-step reasoning accuracy, and reliability in real-world scenarios.
6) Cross-Functional Delivery & Stakeholder Leadership
Partner with Data Engineering to ensure AI-ready datasets, labels, feature availability, data quality standards, and refresh SLAs.
Partner with MLOps/Platform to ensure deployability: model packaging/serving expectations, monitoring telemetry, and retraining automation triggers.
Provide clear leadership updates: progress, risks, mitigation, dependencies, and value realization tracking.
7) People Leadership (Team + Partners)
Lead and mentor a team of 810 Data Scientists; guide performance, capability building, and delivery accountability.
Coordinate partner resources where applicable to ensure quality, velocity, and adherence to standards.
Set strong engineering and DS practices: code reviews, documentation, experiment tracking, and knowledge sharing.

Preferred candidate profile

B.Tech./B.E. or Master’s in Statistics, AI, Economics, Mathematics (or related field) with strong R&D/research experience; PhD in Statistics/AI (or equivalent) is highly preferred.
12–15+ years in Data Science/Applied ML, including 5+ years leading teams/pods and owning production outcomes.
Strong hands-on depth in statistics and ML, with rigorous evaluation practices (AUC/F1, precision/recall, calibration, lift, forecasting metrics, stability testing; causal thinking where relevant).
Proven expertise in feature engineering, experiment design, model selection, and translating business problems into deployable ML solutions.
Production mindset: monitoring/drift strategy, retraining approach, model risk management, and strong documentation discipline.
Strong Python (and working SQL); experience with modern data/AI platforms (Databricks preferred) and large-scale datasets.
Strong stakeholder management and communication across business, engineering, and governance teams.
Retail domain expertise (Must); Oil & Energy (big plus).
Authored whitepapers, publications, or patents in applied ML/AI (preferred).

Opportunity to build and shape an enterprise-grade AI/GenAI platform on Azure Databricks from the ground up.
Work at the intersection of energy, mobility, and digital innovation with high-visibility, high-impact programs.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute to RIL’s broader AI transformation agenda.

You will tackle challenging situations every day and you'll have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon. description:
About The Role  

About The Role



Job Title - S&C Global Network - AI - Healthcare Analytics - Consultant



Management Level:9-Team Lead/Consultant



Location:Bangalore/Gurgaon



Must-have skills:GenAI, RAG, Agentic AI, Python, SQL, AI/ML, Visualization (Power BI or Tableau)




Good to have skills:R, Spark, data bricks, Ability to leverage design thinking, business process optimization, and stakeholder management skills.





Job

Summary:

This role involves driving strategic initiatives, managing business transformations, and leveraging industry expertise to create value-driven solutions.





Roles & Responsibilities:
Deliver strategic advice to clients by providing data-driven recommendations that enhance business outcomes.
Independently manage communications with clients, ensuring clear understanding of project objectives and progress updates.
Design and implement GenAI, RAG, Agentic AI, or traditional AI/ML algorithms tailored to address specific business challenges within the healthcare and life sciences sector.
Demonstrate knowledge of life sciences datasets and maintain strong domain expertise to drive the development of robust analytics solutions.
Support the delivery of consulting projects for global clients, working as part of a small to medium-sized team or as an individual contributor as required.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, leveraging skills in data engineering, data science, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Apply design thinking principles and business process optimization to recommend and implement innovative, value-driven solutions.
Engage in ongoing learning to develop consulting acumen, industry knowledge, and technical capabilities.





WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?
An opportunity to work on high-visibility projects with top Pharma clients around the globe.
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners, and business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge, and capabilities.
Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.





What you would do in this role
Support delivery of small to medium-sized teams to deliver consulting projects for global clients.
Responsibilities may include strategy, implementation, process design, and change management for specific modules.
Work with the team or as an Individual contributor on the project assigned which includes a variety of skills to be utilized from Data Engineering to Data Science
Provide Subject matter expertise in various sub-segments of the LS industry.
Develop assets and methodologies, point-of-view, research, or white papers for use by the team and the larger community.
Acquire new skills that have utility across industry groups.
Support strategies and operating models focused on some business units and assess likely competitive responses. Also, assess implementation readiness and points of greatest impact.
Co-lead proposals, and business development efforts and coordinate with other colleagues to create consensus-driven deliverables.
Execute a transformational change plan aligned with the client’s business strategy and context for change. Engage stakeholders in the change journey and build commitment to change.
Make presentations wherever required to a known audience or client on functional aspects of his or her domain.



Who are we looking for?
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other Quantitative field.
Extensive GenAI expertise with a track record of creating and deploying GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.
Proven experience (4+ years) in working on Life Sciences/Pharma/Healthcare projects and delivering successful outcomes.
Excellent understanding of Pharma data sets – commercial, clinical, RWE (Real World Evidence) & EMR (Electronic medical records)
Leverage one’s hands on experience of working across one or more of these areas such as real-world evidence data, R&D clinical data, digital marketing data.
Hands-on experience with handling Datasets like Komodo, RAVE, IQVIA, Truven, Optum etc.
Hands-on experience in building and deployment of Statistical Models/Machine Learning including Segmentation & predictive modeling, hypothesis testing, multivariate statistical analysis, time series techniques, and optimization.
Proficiency in Programming languages such as Python, SQL, Spark, etc.
Ability to work with large data sets and present findings/insights to key stakeholders; Data management using databases like SQL.
Experience with any of the cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models.
Experience with any of the Data Visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, Qlikview, Spotfire is good to have.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.
Proficient in Excel, MS Word, PowerPoint, etc.
Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.
Strong writing skills to build points of view on current industry trends.
Good communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills



Professional & Technical


Skills:


- Relevant experience in the required domain.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

- Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.






Additional Information:

- Opportunity to work on innovative projects.

- Career growth and leadership exposure.
